scope: East Baton Rouge Parish Mississippi riverfront; full64.321km uncompressed mapped course
projection: EPSG:26915, local meter origin; x east,z south
elevationSampling: Bilinear at GeoTIFF pixel centers; worldY=sourceDEMmeters-4.0
shorelineAdaptation: Only vertices within0.025m of the mapped water boundary are set to worldY=0.15m, aligning differing DEM/shoreline epochs to the gameplay water stage. This is visual shoreline adaptation, not measured river-stage topography.
overlapHandling: Tiles processed in descending priority; each lower-priority land region subtracts all prior image tile footprints. No overlapping overview/core terrain faces.
encoding: positionsB64 Float32 little-endian XYZ; indicesB64 Uint32 little-endian; top-facing winding
refinementDefinition: 70m cells intersecting a70m mapped-shoreline buffer or55m official levee-alignment buffer are subdivided to14m. Transition edges retain all fine-grid points.
